title: Sea Otters Hold Hands While They Sleep
description: Sea otters sleep floating on their backs, and they often hold on to each other so they don't drift apart.

scenes.text: Sea otters often hold hands while they sleep.
scenes.subject: otter
scenes.say: [warmly] Sea otters often hold hands... [chuckles] while they sleep.

scenes.text: They sleep floating on their backs in the ocean, which means the waves could easily carry them away.
scenes.subject: otter
scenes.say: They sleep floating on their backs in the ocean, [worried] which means the waves could easily carry them away.

scenes.text: So they grab on to each other's paws, forming little groups that stay together through the night.
scenes.subject: otter
scenes.say: [softly] So they grab on to each other's paws, forming little groups that stay together through the night.

scenes.text: Some also wrap themselves in long strands of seaweed, like a blanket that keeps them in place.
scenes.subject: otter
scenes.say: Some also wrap themselves in long strands of seaweed, like a blanket that keeps them in place.

scenes.text: The ocean's cutest sleepover. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: otter
scenes.say: [laughs] The ocean's cutest sleepover. [chuckles] Follow for more weird facts.
